verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic automation that touches many items. Graph APIs can automate creating teams and channels, adding people, and configuring channels, tabs and apps in one workflow, and the Teams Export APIs can pull 1:1, group, meeting and channel messages in bulk. Beyond that, bulk work appears to mean scripting individual API calls rather than using a dedicated bulk capability. Missing for 10: explicit bulk or batch write operations (mass edit, delete or move across many items), any bulk-action UI or agent-driven bulk commands, documented batch API semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
